title: Is Competition Only One Click Away? The Digital Markets Act's Impact on Google Maps
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: all 25 EU countries treated at the same time (January 2024) versus 27 non-EU control countries. TWFE with country and week (search) or month (traffic) FE, log outcomes, but only one first-adoption date.
design_notes: Eq. (1): ln Y_it = a_i + w_t + g*(EU_i x post_t) + e_it, clustered by country; Eq. (2) is a fully dynamic EU x time-dummy path with Jan 2024 as reference. Table 3: log Google search volume for 'maps' and 'google maps' (weekly, Jan 2023-Dec 2024), three control-group definitions. Table 4: log visits to google.com/maps, desktop and mobile (monthly). Appendix tables add SDiD and synthetic control. Footnote 12 notes the interface change was rolled out gradually over Jan-Feb 2024, but the authors code a single post date.
screener_notes: Not eligible under Protocol Section 2 (needs >= 2 distinct first-adoption dates). Clean single-date TWFE; if the project ever relaxes the rule to single-date designs this paper would qualify (static and event-study versions, no time-varying controls). No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Data: Google Trends (public), Glimpse (subscription-based scaling), Semrush traffic (proprietary subscription).
